title: Andrew Garfield Says He ‘Never Had Any Interaction’ With Sam Altman While Filming ‘Artificial,’ Despite Altman Claiming They Waved to Each Other: ‘I Was Very Confused By That’
content:
ByPayton Turkeltaub

Andrew Garfieldmight be playing OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in the forthcoming film “Artificial,” but the actor is maintaining that he’s never interacted with the tech billionaire — despite Altman’s claim that thetwo wavedto one another while the film was shooting outside his home.

Garfield was asked about Altman’s anecdote in a recentGQinterview, and he said he “wasn’t there.” “No, I saw that interview and I replayed it a few times to try and discern what he was actually saying, because I was very confused by that. I never had any interaction with him,” said Garfield. “I’ve never seen him in real life. We were shooting outside of his house. It was an eerie day, for sure. We were told that he wasn’t home and his security people were there. I think I saw one security guard. But, no, I never saw Sam, so he maybe mistook someone else for me. I have no idea, but I’ve never waved at Sam. I’ve never seen him. I was curious about that.”

He also added that he “didn’t have a body double,” so that couldn’t have caused the confusion, though a representative for OpenAI told the magazine that “Altman was home during the filming and reiterated that he waved at Garfield.”

Altman had previously toldVanity Fairhe ran into the production filming near his house.

“There were these notices on our street that there was going to be some filming or whatever. I didn’t realize what was going on. I paid no attention,” Altman said. “And then one morning, I was walking down the street to get coffee and there were all these cameras and there was a guy dressed exactly like me with my same backpack walking so much that I felt I was in some weird glitch of the simulation or something. It was very strange. And then I immediately figured out what was happening.”

He added, “We waved and went on, but it was really weird. I mean, it’s like a strange thing to see someone that has nailed your kind of quirky mannerisms or whatever…I waved at him that one time and that was it.”

Directed by Luca Guadagnino, “Artificial” opens in theaters on Christmas Day from Neon. Set during the tumultuous time when Altman was fired and then rehired by the AI giant in 2023, the film also stars Ike Barinholtz as co-founder Elon Musk, Monica Barbaro as former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, “Anora” breakout Yura Borisov as former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever and Mark Rylance as Nobel Prize winner Geoffrey Hinton.
title_zh: 安德魯·加菲爾德(Andrew Garfield)表示，在拍攝《人工智慧》(Artificial)期間，他「從未與山姆·奧特曼(Sam Altman)有過任何互動」，儘管奧特曼聲稱他們彼此揮手致意。他說：「我對此感到非常困惑。」
content_zh:
由佩頓·圖克塔布(Payton Turkeltaub)報導

安德魯·加菲爾德(Andrew Garfield)可能在即將上映的電影《人工智能》(Artificial)中飾演OpenAI首席執行官山姆·阿特曼(Sam Altman)，但這位演員堅稱他從未與這位科技億萬富翁互動過——儘管阿特曼聲稱在拍攝期間他們曾在阿特曼家外互相揮手。

在最近的一次《GQ》訪談中，加菲爾德被問及阿特曼的轶事，他表示自己“當時不在那裡”。“不，我看過那次訪談，並重播了幾次以試圖分辨他到底在說什麼，因為我對此感到非常困惑。我從未與他有過任何互動，”加菲爾德說。“我從未在現實生活中見過他。我們是在他的家外拍攝的。那天確實有些詭異。我們被告知他不在家，他的保安人員在那裡。我想我看到了一名保安。但不，我從未見過山姆，所以他可能把別人誤認為我。我不知道，但我從未向山姆揮手。我從未見過他。我對此感到好奇。”

他還補充說自己“沒有替身”，所以不可能造成混淆，儘管OpenAI的一位代表告訴雜誌，“阿特曼在拍攝期間在家，並重申他向加菲爾德揮手。”

阿特曼之前告訴《名利場》(Vanity Fair)，他在家附近遇到了拍攝團隊。

“我們街上有這些通知，說會有一些拍攝或其他什麼。我當時沒有意識到發生了什麼。我沒有注意到，”阿特曼說。“然後有一天早上，我走在街上去買咖啡，看到有很多攝影機，還有一個穿著和我一模一樣、背著我同樣背包的家伙走來走去，讓我感覺自己好像進入了某種奇怪的模擬故障中。這真的很奇怪。然後我立刻明白發生了什麼。”

他補充道：“我們揮了揮手就走了，但這真的很奇怪。我是說，看到一個完全模仿你那種古怪舉止的人，這是一件奇怪的事情……我那次揮手就這樣了。”

由盧卡·瓜達尼諾(Luca Guadagnino)執導的《人工智能》(Artificial)將於聖誕節在影院上映，出品方為Neon。電影設定在2023年阿特曼被解雇後又被重新聘用的動盪時期，還主演了艾克·巴林霍茲(Ike Barinholtz)飾演聯合創始人埃隆·馬斯克(Elon Musk)、莫妮卡·巴巴羅(Monica Barbaro)飾演前OpenAI首席技術官米拉·穆拉提(Mira Murati)、在《安諾拉》(Anora)中爆紅的尤拉·博里索夫(Yura Borisov)飾演前OpenAI首席科學家伊利亞·蘇茨克維爾(Ilya Sutskever)和馬克·瑞朗斯(Mark Rylance)飾演諾貝爾獎得主傑弗瑞·辛頓(Geoffrey Hinton)。
